text:
Mc1's gate is tied to sn2 instead of vctrl. Mc0 and Mc2, which play the same role in the other stages, both have their gates on vctrl.

**Why this breaks the circuit**
- sn2 is the source node of Mn2, which sits near vss. That leaves Mc1 with almost no gate drive.
- Stage 1 therefore has close to zero pull-down current.
- With one stage unable to discharge, the ring cannot oscillate. That matches the simulation: swing is ~0.3 µV and f_mid, f_lo and f_hi are all n/a.

The sensitivity numbers don't help separate candidates, because they are all ~1e-8 %. That is the signature of a dead oscillator.
